messages:
maya (partnerships): Quick heads-up — HelixEdge listing is stuck in marketplace QA. Procurement is rejecting the PO because the signer on their contract is a subcontractor and our finance requires a direct vendor signatory. Also their EDI vendor alias (54321) doesn't match the EDI on the PO (12345) so automated routing is failing.

juan (sales): Ugh, that's awkward. Did HelixEdge sign our standard MSA or a third-party SOW?

maya (partnerships): They signed a vendor SOW referencing a prime vendor. Contract has a signatory appendix naming "HelixEdge Partners, Inc." but procurement sees the invoicing entity as "HelixEdge Solutions".

liam-legal: Can you paste the exact clause that's tripping procurement? If it's just naming, we can approve a signature delegation letter instead of re-exec.

maya (partnerships): Here's the relevant snippet from the SOW:```Signatory: Authorized representative of HelixEdge Partners, Inc. Billing entity: HelixEdge Solutions, LLC.``` Procurement flagged mismatch + no delegation letter.

francis (finance): For automated PO matching we need the remit-to EIN and EDI to match the vendor record or we have to route invoices manually which delays payment. Also SOC/SOX checklist needs confirmation for payee entity.

keiko (partner-ops): I pinged HelixEdge ops. They say the finance team is overloaded but can produce a signed delegation letter and update EDI mapping if we give them the exact format.

tara-ops: What's the impact if we accept a manual workaround? Can we create a one-off mapping?

francis (finance): Manual mapping is possible but puts the invoice into the "exceptions" queue — typical delay 2–3 billing cycles. Not ideal for a launch.

juan (sales): Launch date is T+5 business days. We either get delegation letter + EDI update now or we delay launch. Which is less risky?

liam-legal: Delegation letter template is trivial. I can draft in 2 hours but procurement wants it notarized in some cases. Can procurement accept an emailed signed PDF? @francis?

francis (finance): Signed PDF is acceptable for vendor onboarding; notarization not required for delegation. But we still need EDI alias change in the marketplace portal to match the PO. That requires HelixEdge to update their vendor settings.

keiko (partner-ops): I asked for portal steps. HelixEdge said they need the marketplace support team to flip the alias on their side — they don't have permission. I'll open a support ticket and CC their finance lead.

marketplace-bot: (auto-note) Support ticket #MKP-8812 created — assigned to marketplace-support. Expected triage within 4 hours.

maya (partnerships): Plan proposal: 1) Liam drafts delegation letter template now. 2) Keiko opens support ticket (done) and requests EDI alias update. 3) Francis pre-approves manual invoice routing fallback if alias update takes >24h, but we block launch if delegation letter not provided. 4) Juan tells HelixEdge launch will be contingent on delegation letter + EDI change.

juan (sales): Agreed. I'll message the partner: short, firm.

liam-legal: Draft posted:```Delegation of Signing Authority: HelixEdge Partners, Inc. hereby delegates authority to sign purchase orders and invoices to HelixEdge Solutions, LLC (email: finance@helixedge.com) for the purpose of invoicing Redwood Inference, with effect from <date>.``` Send back for quick sign.

keiko (partner-ops): Marketplace support replied — they can flip alias but need confirmation of the vendor account ID and a screenshot of the PO showing EDI 12345. Asking HelixEdge to upload both to the ticket.

maya (partnerships): Action items: Juan -> get signed delegation + screenshot of vendor portal; Keiko -> monitor MKP-8812 and escalate to marketplace-support lead if no response in 4h; Francis -> prepare manual routing SOP if needed; Liam -> stand by to accept minor redline if partner requests tiny wording tweak.

francis (finance): If we enable manual routing, add a note to the invoice that payment ETA may be extended. I'll draft the line.

juan (sales): I'll update HelixEdge now and loop in their finance lead. Will post back here with timeline. :thumbsup:

maya (partnerships): Thanks all. If marketplace-support confirms alias flip and we have the signed delegation within 6 hours, we greenlight launch. Otherwise we pause and reschedule.

marketplace-bot: (auto-note) MKP-8812 status update: triaged -> in progress. Marketplace support assigned: @anita-support. ETA 3h.
